name: Weaviate
model: Collections of JSON objects with vectors; vector, BM25 and hybrid search, filters, built-in embedding modules; REST, gRPC, GraphQL
engine_note: Per shard: LSM-tree object store and inverted index, custom HNSW (or flat/dynamic) vector index, WAL; data on local disk, optional offload of cold tenants to S3
consistency: Per-object writes; no multi-object transactions. Data replication is leaderless and eventually consistent with tunable levels ONE, QUORUM (default for reads and writes) or ALL; schema and cluster metadata use Raft. Repaired by read repair and async replication.
scaling: Horizontal: collections split into shards across nodes with a replication factor; multi-tenancy gives each tenant its own shard, which can be set inactive or offloaded to cold storage.
licence: BSD-3-Clause for the core; enterprise features in the 'wl' directory under the proprietary Weaviate License (from 2026)

licence_events.event: Weaviate repo becomes open core: code outside the new 'wl' directory stays BSD-3-Clause, enterprise features inside it need a paid licence key (first in tag v1.39.4)

reach: Reach for it when you want vector plus keyword hybrid search with embedding generation built in, or many isolated tenants each with their own index.
avoid: Avoid if you need strongly consistent reads or multi-object transactions, or a small vector set that pgvector in your Postgres already handles.
escape: It bundles hybrid search, built-in vectorisers and per-tenant shards that plain pgvector leaves to you.
chat: Per-user tenant holding that user's message embeddings for hybrid search over their own history.
